# SMS

Send and receive SMS and MMS from your numbers with POST /v1/sms/messages, with US carrier registration handled through the API.

import { PlatformCapabilities } from '@/components/platform-capabilities';

Send and receive SMS and MMS from your [numbers](/platforms/phone-numbers) with `POST /v1/sms/messages`.

Replies land in the same [inbox](/messages/list-inbox-conversations) as your other channels and arrive as [`message.received`](/webhooks/inbox/message-received) events.

## Quick reference

In the US, a number needs an approved carrier registration to send, not to receive. Zernio runs that registration through the API.

## Before you start

SMS requires usage-based billing.

In the US, a number cannot send until its carrier registration (10DLC or toll-free) is approved. It receives from the moment SMS is on. Approval is asynchronous, so register early.

Every other country sends as soon as SMS is enabled on the number.

## How it fits together

1. Get an SMS-capable number. Not every number can text: [search](/platforms/phone-numbers/setup#step-1-search-available-numbers) with `sms=true`, purchase with `wantsSms: true`, or [port in](/platforms/phone-numbers/porting).
2. Enable SMS and register. Call `POST /v1/phone-numbers/{id}/sms`, then run the US [carrier registration](/platforms/sms/setup). An approved registration you already hold [covers the new number](/platforms/sms/setup#reuse-an-approval-skip-the-fee) with no repeat fee.
3. Send. [Send SMS or MMS](/platforms/sms/sending), respect opt-outs, and read replies in the inbox. For one-way international sends from a brand name instead of a number, use a [sender ID](/platforms/sms/sender-ids).

## Supported countries and pricing

You can send SMS to the destinations in the table below. Any other destination is blocked at send time.

How you reach a destination depends on what you send from:

| Send from | Reaches | Available in |
|---|---|---|
| An SMS-capable number | Recipients in the number's own country only (the US and Canada count as one) | Australia, Belgium, Canada, Lithuania, Netherlands, Poland, Puerto Rico, South Africa, Sweden, United Kingdom, United States, US Virgin Islands |
| A [sender ID](/platforms/sms/sender-ids) | Any destination below except the US, Canada and Puerto Rico, one-way, text only | No number needed |

Outbound SMS meters per segment at the rates below. They are "from" prices: the floor for that destination, since the exact price depends on the receiving carrier.

In the US, carrier fees put most messages at $0.015 to $0.017 per segment.

Inbound SMS is free on most numbers. Where the carrier charges an inbound fee (some US and Canadian routes), it bills at the metered per-segment rate.

Monthly number prices and US 10DLC registration fees are on [Phone pricing](/pricing/phone#sms).
